method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (18 Nov 2026 HKT): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages for OECD, HK IRD/LegCo, SG IRAS/MOF/SSO, and JP NTA. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.

coverage.OECD: Checked 18 Nov 2026: OECD GloBE publications page fetched (latest AG remains September 2026; GIR XML Schema v2.0 still 20 Oct; Full Legislative Review still 11 Sep). Central Record official PDF re-fetched and still current as at 1 May 2026; Qualified SbS Regimes still list only the United States from 1 January 2026. The 4 Nov Tax Certainty Day announcement (updated 12 Nov only to correct MAP inventory/outcome figures) remains 2025 MAP/APA statistics, not a standalone GloBE document. Deloitte World Tax Advisor 13 Nov OECD item is that same Tax Certainty Day statistics release. No new model rules, AG, GIR, Central Record or Full Legislative Review since catalogued items (plenary 30 Oct; GIR XML Schema v2.0 20 Oct; Romania STTR 2 Oct). No standalone OECD GloBE document published since the 30 Oct plenary statement.
coverage.HK: Checked 18 Nov 2026: IRD What's New and GMT/HKMTT page fetched. New 17 Nov What's New item is the List of Debt Instruments and Sovereign Bonds Eligible for Profits Tax Concession or Exemption (as at 30 June 2026), not Pillar Two. No new IRD What's New Pillar Two item after the catalogued 26 Oct Portal BIR82 filing / e-assessments (2–4 Nov entries remain CARF & Amended CRS, not Pillar Two). The 5 Nov LC Paper No. CB(1)1388/2026(01) remains the latest official HK item; legislation not yet gazetted (planned negative vetting Dec 2026, commencement Feb 2027). PwC HK Tax News Flash still ends at Issue 19 (5 Nov); Issue 20 PDF returns 404. Deloitte World Tax Advisor still latest 13 Nov; its HK item is a REIT stamp-duty proposal, not Pillar Two.
coverage.SG: Checked 18 Nov 2026: IRAS Latest Updates (newest item still 12 Nov FEDR for self-employed/platform workers, not Pillar Two; latest Pillar Two e-Tax Guide still 30 Oct Third Edition), IRAS GloBE/DTT page, IRAS Newsroom (newest 17 Nov item is a GST refund-fraud conviction, not Pillar Two), and PwC Singapore Tax News (12 Nov entries are Budget 2027 consultation and FEDR; latest SG Pillar Two entries remain 4 Nov Act 23 and 30 Oct Third Edition guide) fetched. Catalogued items unchanged: Finance (Income Taxes) Act 2026 (Act 23) published Acts Supplement 4 Nov; Third Edition e-Tax Guide (30 Oct); QTI/SBTI list (13 Oct). No new MMT Regulations for safe harbours; no new IRAS guidance or SSO MMT subsidiary legislation since 17 Nov. Deloitte World Tax Advisor 13 Nov SG item restates the already-catalogued QTI list.
coverage.JP: Checked 18 Nov 2026: NTA 新着情報 fetched through 17 Nov (放射性物質に対する酒類の安全性確保のための施策について), which is not Pillar Two. No Pillar Two items after the catalogued 21 Oct GIR AEOI partner list. 17 Nov sake-safety measures; 13 Nov sake-export statistics; 11 Nov driver recruitment; 9 Nov student tax-essay awards; 2 Nov tobacco hand-held stock tax; 30 Oct CbCR EOI partner-list update confirmed non-Pillar Two (CbCR ≠ GIR); 30 Oct e-Gov public comment on 法人税基本通達 is an art-depreciation threshold change, not Pillar Two. GIR EOI hub still points to the October 2026 (令和8年10月) partner list. The 9 Oct 趣旨説明 remains catalogued but falls before the rolling 30-day window starting ~19 Oct. No new JP IIR/QDMTT/GIR administrative guidance. MOF search found no November 2026 Pillar Two publications.
